title: Sickliness
summary: SICK'LINESS, noun [from sickly.] 1. The state of being sickly; the state of being habitually diseased; 2. The state of producing sickness extensively; as the sickliness of a climate. SICK'-LIST, noun

inlines.v: SICK'LINESS, noun [from sickly.] 1. The state of being sickly; the state of being habitually diseased; 2. The state of producing sickness extensively; as the sickliness of a climate. SICK'-LIST, noun A list containing the names of the sick.
